reason: I use AI at work all day, but I'm not letting it move my actual money, and a cute pet doesn't make that feel safer. A new app with no broker named yet and no price is easy to skip. I'll keep doing my monthly buys myself.
objection: Is my data and my brokerage access safe with a brand-new app, and who is on the hook when the agent makes a bad trade with real money? 'Licensed broker partner, later' isn't an answer yet.
would_change_my_mind: A named, regulated broker holding the account with SIPC coverage, plus a mode where the agent only suggests and nothing moves without my tap, with a public track record.
